title: session.start — Begin New Session
description: Client initiates a new session or resumes an existing one after reconnection. This must be the first C2S message sent after WebSocket handshake.

session_id.description: Previous session ID for reconnection, or null for a fresh session.

enable_video.description: Whether the client will stream camera frames.

timezone.description: Client local timezone ID (e.g. "Asia/Shanghai"; on some Android devices "GMT+08:00"). Send the raw system value; the server validates and canonicalizes it, and ignores invalid values. Optional.

language.description: Client app UI language (canonical app locale code), e.g. "en", "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "pt", "ar". Use the app's resolved resource language, not the device locale. Optional; omitted by old clients. The server stores it on the session for later use.

avdetector.description: Optional per-session switch for AVDetector. Omitted = enable (backward compatible: old clients keep current behavior). Explicit null is invalid; the default keyword is annotation only and the server implements the omitted-field fallback.

config.description: Client capability and configuration declaration. Additional properties are allowed for forward compatibility.
